Name: Crest Micro Life Insurance Limited
desc: Crest Micro-Life Insurance is a new entrant to the Nepalese life insurance industry, dedicated to offering dependable and affordable insurance solutions to families and individuals across the country. Our range of insurance products is designed to cater to your unique needs and budget, with personalized advice from our team of experienced professionals.

Name: Guardian Micro Life Insurance Limited
desc: A smart investment for a secure tomorrow Guardian Micro-Life Insurance Limited is Nepal’s first-ever micro insurance company, officially registered on December 26, 2022 and licensed on April 10, 2023. With operations commencing on July 7, 2023, Guardian is not only the pioneer in micro life insurance but also a digital-first insurer, revolutionizing how protection is delivered to underserved families across Nepal. Our affordable, tailored insurance solutions and tech-driven customer service set a new benchmark for accessibility, inclusion, and social impact in the Nepalese insurance landscape. As a mission-driven company, Guardian is committed to empowering communities and securing the future of families through innovation and trust.
